# SEASON STATS AND FIXTURES [italic]Orbital League, 2183 season. All times Gateway Standard. Colony relays run behind.[/italic]
## LEAGUE TABLE - [bold]1. Gateway Comets[/bold], 14 won, 3 lost - [bold]2. Titan Tritons[/bold], 12 won, 5 lost - [bold]3. Mars Red Rovers[/bold], 11 won, 6 lost - [bold]4. Tokyo Orbitals[/bold], 9 won, 8 lost. The Three World Empire's entry, and the best defence in the league. - [bold]5. Arcturus Aces[/bold], 6 won, 11 lost - [bold]6. Luna Lunatics[/bold], 4 won, 13 lost. Spin's boyhood club. He still sends them his old boots. - [bold]7. Spartak Ariarcus[/bold], did not travel. The Union team's transit permits were refused again this year. The league has awarded every match against them to the opposing side, and the Union has awarded every match to Spartak.
## SPIN'S CAREER - [bold]Seasons:[/bold] 10, all with the Comets - [bold]Goals:[/bold] 318, a league record - [bold]Most Valuable Player:[/bold] 2178, 2180, 2182 - [bold]Orbital Cup:[/bold] 2180, 2182 - [bold]Injuries:[/bold] a broken collarbone, a cracked helmet visor and one dislocated finger, caught on the goal ring and put back in by the team medic during play
## GREATEST GOALS - [bold]The Spin[/bold], 2174. The debut goal. Upside down, two rotations, no wall contact. - [bold]The Long Push[/bold], 2180 Orbital Cup final. A push from his own goal ring all the way across the Cage, through four defenders, untouched. Forty metres in under three seconds. - [bold]Blind[/bold], 2182. Scored with his visor fogged white after a collision. He says he heard the ring.
## UPCOMING FIXTURES - [bold]83.08.14[/bold] Comets at Mars Red Rovers, Pavonis Cage - [bold]83.08.28[/bold] Comets v Tokyo Orbitals, Gateway Cage - [bold]83.09.11[/bold] Comets at Titan Tritons, Huygens Cage. The rematch. - [bold]83.10.02[/bold] Exhibition tour of the Outer Veil. The Comets will play in a portable Cage on colonies with a big enough hangar. Ask your administration whether yours qualifies.
